detected_issues: _changes attached to shared db.session introduced thread-safety issues
Index updates lacked atomicity leading to race conditions
Events were bound to db.session instead of Session class
fix_summary: SearchableMixin now stores changes in session.info['search_changes'], checks existence and type, clears after commit, and uses a global lock to perform atomic index updates. Events now bind to SQLAlchemy Session class and dispatch to SearchableMixin subclasses.
test_results: All tests executed to verify concurrent commits, missing/leftover changes, rollback handling, and basic transaction isolation. Tests passed locally after the fix.
notes: Earlier test run (pre-fix) showed failures due to AttributeError from attempting to use session.registry. That was fixed by iterating SearchableMixin subclasses.
